ciudad_vieja.name: Ciudad Vieja
ciudad_vieja.hours: Always open; liveliest daytime and early evening
ciudad_vieja.tip: Start at Plaza Independencia and walk down Calle Sarandí toward the port. Some side streets are quiet at night, so stay on busy ones after dark.

palacio_salvo.name: Palacio Salvo
palacio_salvo.price_text: Exterior free; interior visits vary, check on the day
palacio_salvo.hours: Lobby hours vary; check on the day
palacio_salvo.tip: Look up from Plaza Independencia for the best photo of this 1920s tower. Ask at the entrance about access to upper floors.

plaza_independencia.name: Plaza Independencia
plaza_independencia.tip: This square splits the old town from the centre. Use it as your landmark for meeting and orienting.

teatro_solis.name: Teatro Solís
teatro_solis.price_text: Guided tours and tickets vary; check the day's programme
teatro_solis.hours: Box office and tour times vary; check on the day
teatro_solis.tip: Book a guided tour or a cheap concert ticket to see the restored interior. Check the programme online before you go.

castillo_pittamiglio.name: Castillo Pittamiglio
castillo_pittamiglio.price_text: Guided visit only; price varies, check on the day
castillo_pittamiglio.hours: Guided visits on set days; check on the day
castillo_pittamiglio.tip: You can only enter on a guided tour, so check times before travelling out to the coast.

chivito.name: Chivito (national sandwich)
chivito.hours: Most restaurants lunch and evening; check on the day
chivito.tip: Order the full chivito al pan once — it is a meal in itself. Share if you are not very hungry.

estadio_centenario.name: Estadio Centenario
estadio_centenario.price_text: Museum and tour prices vary; check on the day
estadio_centenario.hours: Check match days and museum hours on the day
estadio_centenario.tip: Built for the first World Cup in 1930. Check whether the football museum is open before you go.
estadio_centenario.best: Daytime; avoid match days unless you have tickets

fortaleza_cerro.name: Fortaleza del Cerro
fortaleza_cerro.price_text: Small entry fee may apply; check on the day
fortaleza_cerro.hours: Daytime only; check on the day
fortaleza_cerro.tip: The hill gives wide views over the bay and city. Go in daylight and take a taxi or bus rather than walking up alone.

legislative_palace.name: Legislative Palace of Uruguay
legislative_palace.price_text: Guided visits may be free; check on the day
legislative_palace.hours: Weekday guided visits only; check on the day
legislative_palace.tip: Visits are usually by guided tour on weekdays. Bring ID and check the schedule in advance.

mercado_puerto.name: Mercado del Puerto
mercado_puerto.hours: Busiest at lunch; many stalls close early evening, check on the day
mercado_puerto.tip: Come hungry at lunch for parrilla (grilled meat). Prices are higher than elsewhere in the city.

catedral_metropolitana.name: Metropolitan Cathedral of Montevideo
catedral_metropolitana.hours: Open daytime; check on the day
catedral_metropolitana.tip: Step inside for the calm interior, then walk the surrounding old-town streets.

rambla.name: Rambla de Montevideo waterfront walk
rambla.tip: Walk or rent a bike along the long coastal promenade. Sunset over the river is the highlight.

mercado_agricola.name: Mercado Agrícola de Montevideo
mercado_agricola.price_text: Free to enter; food prices vary
mercado_agricola.hours: Daytime into evening; check on the day
mercado_agricola.tip: A covered market with local produce and food stalls. Good for a casual lunch away from the old town crowds.

pocitos_beach.name: Playa Pocitos
pocitos_beach.tip: City beach on the Rambla. Check water quality signs before swimming.

carrasco_walk.name: Carrasco neighbourhood walk
carrasco_walk.tip: Leafy streets and old villas near the coast. Take a taxi or bus out and walk in daylight.

tango_show.name: Tango or candombe evening show
tango_show.tip: Ask your hotel for a current venue. Candombe drumming is strongest around the old town on weekends.

free_walking_tour.name: Old town free walking tour
free_walking_tour.hours: Usually daily; check on the day
free_walking_tour.tip: Tours meet near Plaza Independencia. Confirm the meeting point and time the day before.

puerto_viewpoint.name: Port and bay viewpoint near the old town
puerto_viewpoint.tip: Walk to the port edge for views over the bay and Mercado del Puerto. Stay in daylight.
